title: My Ban Appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to accept your appeal because your ban was almost a year ago. However, if you are banned again you will no longer have the chance to appeal.

Welcome back and enjoy the server! :)

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Administrator
